newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-MBIA Inc sets $100 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-MBIA Inc sets $100 mln in debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from MBIA Inc was priced on Monday, said lead manager Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securites Corp.
MBIA Inc, based in Armonk, New York, insures municipal bonds, asset-backed securities and other non-municipal bonds through its wholly-owned subsidiary, MBIA Insurance Corp.
Proceeds from the offering will be used to provide additional capital for the future needs of the firm, MBIA Corp and general corporate purposes, the company said.
